column1: # Normalisation table: Granzotti et al. 2026 taxon-string GRAMMAR -> codhmo determinacy concept.
# Determinacy is a property of the authors' attribution, carried on the belief node with
#   crminf:J5_holds_to_be. It is NOT derived from the observation->belief edge
#   (codhmo:supports / compatibleWith): a belief backed by two peptides, one discriminating
#   and one not, has two edges of different strength but a single determinacy.
# PARSE ORDER (all four steps, in this order):
#   1. split on the parenthesis boundary -- the comma before "(" is OPTIONAL
#        "X, (Y, Z)"  44 rows | "X (Y, Z)"  3 rows | "(Y, Z)"  4 rows | "X, Y, Z"  140 rows
#      A comma-split alone mis-groups X with Y in the 3 no-comma rows.
#   2. comma-split each side independently
#   3. map any " x " member to its nothogenus (a hybrid can be ONE MEMBER of a comma
#      list, e.g. "(Secale cereale x Triticum turgidum subsp. durum, Triticum intermedium)",
#      so this runs AFTER the comma split, not before; hybrids never contain a comma)
#   4. split remaining "/" members -- see indistinguishable
# S2 counts are of the 192 data rows of Table S2; 51 carry parentheses, matching the source.
